messages.subject: Re: Turkey MAP
parts:
Taking a chance here that you are trying to create a simple map of the
country Turkey and are not performing some exotic statistical assessment
of the distribution of wild turkeys in De Soto county, Florida.

http://gadm.org/country gives you something like TUR_adm0.RData
(multiple formats available, including shapefiles, but this gets you a
passivated instance of a SpatialPolygonsDataFrame, which is the
intermediate object you want anyway).

require("sp")
require("ggplot2")

load("TUR_adm0.RData") # assumes saved in the current directory
# likely results in an instance of SpatialPolygonsDataFrame as gadm

turkey<-fortify.SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(gadm) # from ggplot2
qplot(long,lat,data=turkey, geom="path")

This will (just) get you started.

See also
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/coord_map.html,

http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/search?group=ggplot2&q=SpatialPolygonsDataFrame&qt_g=Search+this+group,


and http://cran.r-project.org/web/views/Spatial.html.

Let us know what you end up with.

Mark
